_comment: Every plugin here has a `version`, but none of them may reach ls-remote at all -- the gate
in resolve.lua's plugin loop must exclude all three, for three different reasons (`tag`,
`commit`, and `version = false`). The url is a fixed, nonexistent path rather than a
placeholder: if the gate regressed and let one of these through, ls-remote would fail against
it and the check would fail with classification C instead of silently doing the wrong thing.
